sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Runner purpose and imports
sections.what: Explains that this file is the thin shell around the checker: it looks up, checks, saves a record, and returns the result.
sections.why: The header says a provenance gate that cannot show where its own rate came from cannot judge anything else.
sections.watch_out: Logic that belongs in the checker should not be added here, so the checker stays testable.

sections.name: RunE25Options
sections.title: Run options
sections.what: Defines the one option: skip the save step, used for dry runs and test fixtures.
sections.why: The comment says it lets trial runs avoid writing records.
sections.watch_out: A caller that forgets this option will write a record on every test.

sections.name: runE25
sections.title: Running the gate
sections.what: Checks the artifact's mode, stops if off, then runs the lookup, snapshot, checker, and optional save in order, returning the report.
sections.why: The function is the one place that ties the steps together.
sections.watch_out: An off mode returns nothing, so callers must handle a missing report.

sections.name: writeGateComputationRecord
sections.title: Saving the gate's own record
sections.what: Writes one calculation record per artifact, per run, per engine version. A repeat run updates the existing row instead of adding another.
sections.why: The comment says the artifact ID is stored in the field path so two artifacts from the same run can coexist.
sections.watch_out: The key includes the engine version, so changing the engine version creates a new row instead of replacing the old one.

summary: Runs the provenance gate on one artifact: looks up evidence, checks the numbers, saves a record of the result, and returns the report.
purpose: The single entry point the rest of the app calls to run the gate on an artifact.
why: The header says the gate records its own arithmetic, so its rate can be traced like any other number.
how: Reads the mode for the artifact and stops if it is off. Otherwise it looks up evidence, builds the snapshot, runs the pure checker, saves a calculation record unless told not to, and returns the report.
inputs: An artifact reference with an ID and optional run details, a list of numerals, and options that can skip the save.
outputs: The gate report, or nothing when the mode is off.
risks: Every run writes to the database unless the save is skipped. The save has no error handling, so a database failure stops the run.
debug: If no record appears, check that the mode is not off, the save is not skipped, and the artifact ID is set. If a record shows old numbers, the engine version may not have changed.
